capabilities: Display daily notes on a calendar and create or open them from calendar tiles
Review past daily notes in an on-this-day sidebar pane with configurable notifications
Import an existing journal from a Diarium export, including attachments and properties
Set a per-note rating that shows in the status bar with customizable icons
Convert the date format of existing daily notes and insert timestamps
extras: The README states the plugin is unofficial to both Obsidian and Diarium, and lists Diarium features it intentionally excludes (timeline, map, encryption) with suggested alternative plugins.
intentEvidence: This plugin adds functionality from the Diarium journal app to the note-taking app
motivation: The author built it for personal use, saying the plugin "started as a project for my own personal use".
problem: Obsidian's daily notes lack a calendar overview, past-entry review prompts, journal migration from apps like Diarium, and per-day ratings.

relations.evidence: This plugin adds functionality from the Diarium journal app to the note-taking app

summary: Journaling toolkit that adds a daily-notes calendar, on-this-day review, Diarium import, note ratings, timestamps, and a date format converter.
